reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: Nereus still describes NXUSD as an overcollateralized borrow against crypto collateral in its Avalanche and Polygon lending markets. docs.nereus.finance now redirects to the marketing landing page, and neither the landing page nor the pinned GitHub deployment manifest publishes a reconciled, dated per-market collateral inventory or weights. The envelope therefore remains one aggregate classified basket rather than invented weights. The curated-validated adapter probes live token supply and carries this reviewed composition into runtime scoring. Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (Lane39Nereus), reviewed 2026-10-09T10:36:34Z: the issuer landing page and redirected docs still provide product links and expressly disclaim completeness/currentness. The functioning NXUSD interface exposes selected market TVL, borrowed and available amounts, but those figures do not establish an exhaustive common-clock, USD-valued reserve-to-liability inventory across deployments. The pinned deployment repository is a technical deployment inventory, not a current financial composition. No percentages, compositionAsOf, prior review date, financial assurance or custody claims are refreshed by this negative disclosure review; its exact reserve-composition cause is recorded separately in the campaign fragment.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nereus protocol documentation; per-market collateral weights are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Round-2 browser recovery on 2026-10-01 found five additional debt-bearing Avalanche markets beyond the historical 17-Cauldron manifest: aAvaUSDT (0x51a8ff60fbaf277df02eeadc011f5c26dbae1991), aAvaUSDC (0x2ecbcb8757f43676b5d280e706b1a2c0d1975b6a), aAvaDAI (0x2d2005feeabaf7dc54ebd9b33115a2fb6e2a80da), qiUSDCn (0x9fb5a0bbee451643504524ddbfce8a1e09783d5b) and NRS (0x6d0cc0e3e2c63f84b55d86b4a1312805c3b99a2c). At Avalanche block 96542834, each exposed nonzero totalBorrow and totalCollateralShare, its application-matched collateral address and BentoBox 0x0b1f9c2211f77ec3fa2719671c5646cf6e59b775. The live application also lists Polygon and Base networks. Raw shares and application TVL do not establish a reconciled, USD-valued whole-system composition: complete market/deployment coverage, receipt-token look-through, share conversion and a priced denominator remain required. No dependency weight is inferred. Separate technical census by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L15Nereus), observed 2026-10-09T11:49:46.306Z and 2026-10-09T11:50:09.398Z, pins Avalanche block 97119992, hash 0xebcc7701efe8a92220904e8fddc8987dd6e9491256c1b3e3edcfcadd6b3db467, timestamp 2026-10-09T11:49:19.000Z. DegenBox owner is 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467, pendingOwner is zero, and getAllPools returns 25 factory pools. All five selected markets still have nonzero borrow/collateral shares and the same DegenBox. For each selected collateral, strategy and pendingStrategy are zero, strategyData is zero and totals elastic equals base. Four receipt-token markets map to whitelisted master 0xe767c6c3bf42f550a5a258a379713322b6c4c060; NRS maps to non-whitelisted master 0x4ba20b106315ab1b16e91e9ffd264904b3faf761. Non-whitelisted status is not proof that prior signed user approvals are absent. Source permits owner-managed delayed strategy replacement and user-approved master-contract share transfers; these state findings do not certify no freeze/seizure reach. Self-registered masters are not included by getAllPools, and other factory collateral, approvals, direct deployments and non-Avalanche markets remain outside this selected census. No access-graph denominator, composition date, custody safeguard or dependency percentage is changed.
